critical.issue: Cut-the-Fat Phase 1 removal is INCOMPLETE. During the 2m test window with the bot running, 5 calls to api.helius.xyz/v0/addresses were observed in backend.err.log — the acceptance criteria require ZERO such calls. Root causes: (a) creator_audit is still wired into bot._enter_impl (lines 3301-3313) and runs whenever config.creator_audit_enabled is True, which it currently is by default (/api/bot/config returns creator_audit_enabled=true, wallet_graph_enabled=true, serial_creator_gate_enabled=true). (b) WalletGraphHunter is still instantiated and set as a global in server.py:136-137. Either the code paths must be removed, or the config defaults must be forced to False and the UI/config stripped so operators cannot flip them back. The record_new_launch call in bot.py:1241 is OK (comment confirms the Helius Enhanced backfill was moved to a lazy ensure_backfill()).

minor.issue: Stale config keys for the removed features still exist in bot config schema and ship enabled=True by default: creator_audit_enabled, wallet_graph_enabled, serial_creator_gate_enabled. If the features are truly cut, these keys should be removed from the model or defaulted to false and marked deprecated.

UI side effects already covered in this iteration. frontend-api-v3.pump.fun/coins lazy socials fetch count during the window was 110 vs 300+ launches seen in /api/launches/recent — lazy fetch is working correctly (far fewer than launches).
rca of the issue: Phase 1 'Cut the Fat' refactor removed UI surfaces and nav tabs cleanly, but server-side modules (creator_audit, wallet_graph) remain wired into the hot path through still-enabled config flags. Hot-path invocation at bot.py:3301-3313 reaches creator_audit.audit() for every gate-passing mint, which inside performs httpx.get('https://api.helius.xyz/v0/addresses/{creator}/transactions', limit=100). Mitigation: either (a) default and lock creator_audit_enabled/wallet_graph_enabled to False and drop the import/instantiation, or (b) delete the lingering call sites and modules entirely. Preferred: (b), because leaving dead modules in-tree is what triggered this incomplete-refactor finding.
